thread:
maria_sales: Heads-up Acme POC can't finish user provisioning. They POST a single 10k-user SCIM payload and get 413 from their edge or 429 intermittently. POC demo tomorrow morning. Need a short-term path for them to proceed.

sam_se: 413 = payload too large from some HTTP proxy. 429 = rate limit. Which side is returning the 413? Our logs or theirs?

anita_devops: Customer shared request dump. They do one big JSON array to /scim/v2/Users. Their fronting ADFS proxy has max body and times out long requests. Recommend chunking into smaller batches (250-1000) + exponential backoff on 429/5xx.

kevin_security: Also confirm auth. If they're using short-lived SAML-session tokens for the service account, long uploads could expire. Are they using client_credentials for the SCIM service account?

maria_sales: They said it's a service account via client_credentials but the token rotates every 30m. They retried and still got 413. Ops asked if we can temporarily issue a hosted provisioning key to bypass their proxy for the demo (short-lived, IP allowlist).

sam_se: We can create a scoped hosted API key limited to SCIM write endpoints, TTL 48h, and IP allowlist to their jumpbox. For Dedicated/Private we advise running the sync from inside their VPC or using our SCIM relay.

kevin_security: Fine with a 48h scoped key, must be flagged "provisioning-only", IP restricted, and have audit logging. I'll record approval in the ticket.

anita_devops: Quick mitigation snippet to share with customer:

```bash
# chunk 500 users per request, exponential backoff on 429/5xx
for f in chunks/*.json; do
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \\n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVISIONING_KEY" \\n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n    -d "@$f" || sleep 2
done
```

anita_devops: Also recommend they tune their proxy to allow larger body or enable streaming JSON parsing if they want one-shot imports. For repeated large syncs we suggest deltas instead of full replacement.

maria_sales: @ingress_bot can you pull gateway logs for tenant acme-inc last 6h to confirm where 413 originates?

ingress_bot: Created ticket INC-4599. Pulled gateway + edge logs  summary: majority of 413s originate at customer edge (ADFS proxy). A few 429s seen at our gateway during retries. Logs attached to INC-4599.

sam_se: Plan: 1) Issue 48h provisioning key (kevin to approve) 2) Send chunking script + backoff guidance 3) Provide quick doc on Dedicated/Private SCIM relay options 4) If still blocked, 16:00 PST deep-dive call.

maria_sales: I'll get their jumpbox IP for allowlisting and confirm demo timing.

kevin_security: Approval posted in INC-4599. Key created with IP allowlist and expiration. Audit logging enabled.

anita_devops: Follow-up: If they expect regular large imports, suggest using our SCIM relay inside their network or provisioning from a machine in their VPC for Dedicated/Private customers. Also consider incremental syncs using updated timestamps.

maria_sales: Thanks team 44d I'll update Acme and close the loop after the demo.
